items.applies_to: All the as-cast and annealed alloys
items.quote: All the as-cast and annealed alloys were then crushed, powdered and investigated by XRD with Si as an internal standard.
In the examined temperature range, the accuracy of the temperature measurement was estimated to be ±2 K.
The phase transition temperatures in the range of 55-82 at.% Zr were measured by DTA (DSC404C, Netzsch, Germany) on the annealed samples 5#, 7#, 8#, 9# and 11#.

items.calibration: pure Zr and GaAs as standard materials
items.quote: In order to determine the compositions of phases and the solubility of Ga in Zr at 1373 K, the samples were analyzed by electron probe microanalysis (EPMA) (JXA-8530F, JEOL, Japan) with pure Zr and GaAs as standard materials.
XRD was performed using Cu Ka1 radiation on a Rigaku D-max/ 2250 VB + X-ray diffractometer at 40 kV and 250 mA.
The enthalpy of formation of aGaZr was determined using a high temperature reaction calorimeter with the calorimeter temperature set at 1373 ± 2 K under a protective argon atmosphere.
The measurements were performed between room temperature to 1773 K with heating and cooling rates of 10 K/min under an argon atmosphere.
Samples were produced by mixing element powders in a mortar in the designed molar ratio, and pressing them into a small pellet.
